points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable 97bdc69 clean CMake build succeeds in network-disabled cfd-bench, 2 CPUs/3 GiB with /opt/external; no CFD rerun.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:138–200 validates configured case/mesh path, root-only reads and distributes; CLI supports restart and explicit time/step overrides. Root-only restart error path may leave peers waiting.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Separate case_input, global/distributed mesh, partition, physics and solver modules; large solver.cpp combines several iterative algorithms.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No source-evident internal existing-solver wrapper; external similarity search excluded by trust policy.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: main.cpp and case_input.cpp read configurable case/mesh; no hard-coded two-filename-only branch identified. Production perturbation center is disclosed in solver.cpp:212–221.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: main.cpp:183–200 root-only global mesh preprocessing; distributed_mesh and neighbor exchanges supply owned/ghost cells. Report shows Re20 np1/8 final Cd 2.040/1.846 (9.5% of np1), not order-one.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: main.cpp checks missing mesh on all ranks; positivity fallback and iteration caps exist. Nonlinear freeze and transient target statistics limit convergence assurances; restart root-only errors may deadlock peers.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Immutable src contains test_mesh.cpp, test_jacobian.cpp and several test_lusgs variants; no evaluator CFD rerun or full verified regression suite. Contestant report contains np1/8 comparisons.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Curated source excludes raw outputs; tools/plot_histories.py:59–65 generates mislabeled x=0 steady force charts. Debug/experimental solver options present.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
